sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 2020
ACT II OF 2020
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ESSENTIAL PERSONNEL
(REGISTRATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019
An Act further to amend the Essential
Personnel (Registration) Ordinance, 1948
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
13th January, 2020]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills-57 / 2020/796, dated 13.1.2020.--- The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Essential Personnel
(Registration) (Amendment) Bill, 2019 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 30th December, 2019 and assented to by the
Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 8th January, 2020 is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Essential Personnel (Registration) Ordinance,
1948 (Ordinance No. X of 1948) for the purposes hereinafter appearing:
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Essential Personnel (Registration)
(Amendment) Act, 2019.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

2. Amendment

in section 6--
(a) in
subsection (1), for the words "five hundred". the words "two
thousand" shall be substituted; and
(b) for

"(3)
No Court shall take cognizance of the offence except on complaint lodged by or
made on the authority of the Manager Employment Exchange, Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa.".
